teams.synopsis: Back to number 1 in no time (bye bye, Bran) - top 4 players combining for 80+ points weekly.
teams.blurb: Back to number 1 in no time (bye bye Bran XD). Top 4 players combine for an average of 80+ points weekly. <mark class="hl-player">Pop Douglas</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Tyrone</mark> could be valuable.

teams.synopsis: This team just can't stay healthy - great wide receivers, but RB2 is the biggest weakness.
teams.blurb: Team just can't stay healthy. Great wide receivers. Biggest weakness is RB2.

teams.synopsis: Despite being 2-4, SPF remains top 3 in the rankings - set up for failure this week due to byes.
teams.blurb: Despite being 2-4, SPF remains top 3 in the rankings. Set up for failure this week due to byes. <mark class="hl-player">Brown</mark>'s players are potentially valuable, <mark class="hl-player">Chubb</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Jeudy</mark>.

teams.synopsis: Mixon is back and hasn't skipped a beat - when this team is complete, it's scary.
teams.blurb: <mark class="hl-player">Mixon</mark> back and hasn't skipped a beat. Health could be an issue with <mark class="hl-player">MHJ</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Jones</mark>. When team is complete, it's scary.

teams.synopsis: A big drop from 1 to 5, but a bounce back in Week 7 seems inevitable.
teams.blurb: Big drop from 1 to 5, but a bounce back in Week 7 seems inevitable. <mark class="hl-player">Njoku</mark> getting back into shape, now top target with no <mark class="hl-player">Cooper</mark>. <mark class="hl-player">White</mark> seems like a lost cause, but when healthy the team has zero weakness.

teams.synopsis: Hard to rank - 4th-fewest points scored, but a bright future with Caleb and Kmet still unproven.
teams.blurb: Hard to rank - 4th-least points scored, but bright future. Are <mark class="hl-player">Caleb</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Kmet</mark> great... we won't know for another week. Wide receiver trio of <mark class="hl-player">Billy</mark>, <mark class="hl-player">Evans</mark>, and <mark class="hl-player">McLaren</mark> is class.

teams.synopsis: A solid playoff-caliber team, but still inconsistent - keep an eye on Davante Adams.
teams.blurb: Looking like a solid playoff team, but inconsistent. Some solid trade pieces on the team. <mark class="hl-player">Davante Adams</mark>???

teams.synopsis: Dropping out of the top 5 for the first time all season - a lot left to prove in the coming weeks.
teams.blurb: Dropping out of top 5 for the first time all season. <mark class="hl-player">Mark Andrews</mark> could be on the rise, but we shall see. Team has a lot to prove in the next few weeks.

teams.synopsis: One of the sneakiest teams in the league (projected 122.7) - Mahomes may be one of the year's biggest busts.
teams.blurb: One of the sneakiest teams in the league (projected 122.7). <mark class="hl-player">Mahomes</mark> may be one of the biggest busts this year. Needs <mark class="hl-player">Pittman</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">Sutton</mark> to contribute to win big games down the stretch (TFR, JALL, MM).

teams.synopsis: Daniels is the real deal (projected 25.2) - once Taylor gets healthy, this team gets very capable.
teams.blurb: <mark class="hl-player">Daniels</mark> is the real deal, man (projected 25.2). Once <mark class="hl-player">Taylor</mark> gets healthy the team will be very capable. Wide receivers outplaying expectation.

teams.synopsis: Back on track, maybe - Chris Godwin has been incredible, and Nacua is returning in a few weeks.
teams.blurb: Back on track??? <mark class="hl-player">Chris Godwin</mark> has been incredible (WR1). <mark class="hl-player">Nacua</mark> returning in a few weeks.

teams.synopsis: Finally got a win, even without Adams - another one or two keeps him clear of the punishment.
teams.blurb: Finally got a win!!! <mark class="hl-player">Adams</mark> to Jets... just as <mark class="hl-player">Wilson</mark> was looking good :( Not eliminated from playoffs, but another win or two will save him from punishment.

teams.synopsis: The first two picks haven't hit, and there's no real top dog on the roster - keep an eye on Amari Cooper.
teams.blurb: First two picks did not hit. No real 'top dog' on the team. <mark class="hl-player">Amari Cooper</mark>???

teams.synopsis: Back to being bad - the lone team with zero wins, with only Burrow and London giving reason for hope.
teams.blurb: Back to being bad. Now the lone team with 0 wins. Again, <mark class="hl-player">Burrow</mark> and <mark class="hl-player">London</mark> are the only positives.
